info.title: NOVR Events API
info.description: REST API for NOVR Events, the cybersecurity event management platform by Cybernovr. Authentication uses an HTTP-only session cookie; state-changing requests made with a session must also send the `X-CSRF-Token` header returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/session`.

Serves banners, logos, avatars and speaker photos. Private form uploads are never served here.

post.summary: Sign out of the current session

get.description: Always returns 200. `authenticated` is false for anonymous visitors. The `csrfToken` must be sent as `X-CSRF-Token` on state-changing requests.

post.summary: Verify an email address with the emailed token
Email a new verification link to an unverified address (no sign-in needed)
post.description: Responds identically whether or not the address belongs to an unverified account. Rate limited, and at most one email per minute per account.

post.summary: Finish or skip the one-time welcome
post.description: Idempotent. The first completion time is kept.
Responds identically whether or not the address belongs to an account.

post.summary: Set a new password with the emailed token
post.description: Signs out every existing session for the account.

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in account
post.description: Other sessions are signed out; the current one stays active.
Requires the current password. The new address must be verified again.

get.summary: List active sessions for the signed-in account

post.summary: Sign out every session except the current one

get.summary: Get your own profile and privacy settings

patch.description: All fields are optional. `publicFields` selects which optional fields appear publicly. `shareRegistrations` is off by default and, when on, shows your confirmed registrations for public events to your followers only.

post.description: multipart/form-data with one image file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB). The image is re-encoded, resized and stripped of metadata before it is stored.

get.description: Returns only the fields the owner has made public. Private profiles return 404.

get.summary: QR code for a public profile
get.description: Encodes the public profile URL. This is unrelated to event ticket QR codes.

post.description: Idempotent. Only public profiles can be followed.

get.summary: List the followers of a public profile
List who a public profile follows

post.description: Idempotent. Suspended or unknown organisations return 404.

delete.description: Idempotent. Works even after the organisation is suspended.

get.summary: List notifications for the signed-in user

post.description: Optional. Individuals can organise events without one. The creator becomes the owner.

get.summary: List the organizations you belong to
Get an organization you belong to

post.summary: Upload an organization logo (owner or admin)
Add a member by username (owner or admin)

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave the organization

get.summary: List events you organise or help run
get.description: Includes events you own, events whose team you are on, and events of organizations you administer.

post.description: Any signed-in user can create an event. A default "General Admission" ticket type is added.

patch.description: Covers details, schedule, location, capacity, visibility and branding (accent colour).

delete.summary: Delete a draft event that has no registrations

post.summary: Upload the event banner or logo
post.description: multipart/form-data with one JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.

delete.summary: Remove the event banner or logo

post.description: Requires a verified email address and a complete listing. Returns 422 `EVENT_INCOMPLETE` with the missing details. Followers of the organiser are notified the first time a public event goes live.

post.summary: Return a published event to draft
post.description: Only possible while nobody has registered.

post.summary: Cancel an event (owner or organization admin)
post.description: Voids all tickets and, unless disabled, emails attendees a cancellation notice.

post.summary: Archive a draft, completed or cancelled event
Duplicate an event into a new draft
post.description: Copies the listing, ticket types, speakers and agenda. Registrations and images are not copied.

get.description: Lists public, published events. Filter by discovery mode (scope), date, location, category, format (mode), price, organiser, registration availability and event type; sort and paginate.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Discovery mode. "cybersecurity" lists only events in a cybersecurity category.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Matches city, region, country or venue.

parameters.name: registration
parameters.description: Only events that can be registered for right now.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only events that end on or after this date (UTC).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only events that start on or before this date (UTC).

get.description: Unlisted events are reachable by link. Private events need the `key` from the share link, unless the viewer is registered or on the event team. The join link is only included for confirmed attendees.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Share key, required for PRIVATE events.

get.description: Times are UTC, so every calendar shows the right moment. Same visibility rules as the event page; the join link and organiser email are never included.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Share key, required for PRIVATE events.

post.description: Anonymous beacon. No cookies; the visitor key is a daily-rotating hash.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Share key, required for PRIVATE events.

post.description: Available to everyone. One report per account (or network address) per event.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Share key, required for PRIVATE events.

delete.summary: Remove an event from your saved list

get.summary: Events published by people you follow
Public events organised by a user
Events a user is registered for (followers only, opt-in)
get.description: Private by default. Returns `visible: false` with no items unless the profile owner enabled sharing and the viewer follows them. Only confirmed registrations for public events are ever listed.

post.description: Session times must fall within the event’s start and end.

post.summary: Add a team member by username (owner or organization admin)
post.description: MANAGER can run the event. STAFF can only check attendees in.

delete.summary: Remove a team member, or leave the team

post.summary: Create a task or checklist item
Add the standard event preparation checklist
post.description: Adds only the standard items the event does not already have.

patch.description: Check-in staff can only change the status of tasks assigned to them.

get.description: Includes your own forms, forms of events you manage, and forms of organizations you administer.

post.description: Creates a draft form, standalone or attached to an event. Every purpose uses the same form engine; the purpose only chooses the starting questions and defaults. A REGISTRATION form must be attached to an event and becomes that event’s registration form.

get.summary: Get a form for the builder

patch.summary: Update form settings and operational rules
patch.description: Closing date, response limit (counts qualifying responses), duplicate rule, automatic acceptance, confirmation message and data retention. These take effect immediately and do not create a new version.

delete.summary: Delete a form and its responses
delete.description: Not allowed for a registration form that has produced registrations.

put.summary: Save the draft definition (steps, questions and rules)
put.description: Replaces the working copy. Published versions are immutable: saving after a publish starts a new draft version, and existing responses keep the version they answered.

post.description: Makes the draft live at the form’s stable public URL. Returns 422 `FORM_INCOMPLETE` with the problems found.
Stops accepting responses. The public URL stays valid and explains that the form is unavailable.
Copies questions, rules and settings into a new draft. Responses are not copied.

get.summary: List the versions of a form
Get a published form for rendering
get.description: No account is needed. Returns the questions and the SHOW/REQUIRE rules for conditional logic. Exclusion rules are never included.

post.summary: Record that a form was viewed or started
post.description: Anonymous funnel beacon, de-duplicated per page load by `sessionKey`.

Stores the response and returns a neutral acknowledgement. `status: RECEIVED` means the response was stored — acceptance is only stated when it is true. Errors: 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 409 `FORM_CLOSED` / `FORM_FULL` / `EVENT_FULL` / `DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION` / `FORM_UPDATED`. Use the `/upload` variant when the form has file questions.

post.summary: Submit a response with file uploads
post.description: multipart/form-data. The `payload` text part holds the same JSON as the plain submission endpoint; each file is a part named `file:<questionKey>`. Files are checked by content, not by name, and stored privately.

get.description: Search (name, email and answer text), filter by qualification, decision, date range or a specific answer, and sort. `fields` lists every question across versions for column headers.
Accepts the same filters as the list. Cells are protected against spreadsheet formula injection.

post.description: For applications and other non-registration forms. Excluded responses cannot be accepted.

get.summary: Download a file attached to a response
get.description: Always served as a download, never rendered inline.
Search by name, email or ticket code. Available to the whole event team, including check-in staff.

get.summary: Export attendees and attendance as CSV

post.summary: Approve a pending registration (issues the ticket)
Cancel a registration as the organiser
post.description: Voids the ticket, frees the place and emails the attendee.

get.summary: Download your ticket (PDF) or its QR code
View a registration through its private link
get.description: For guests without an account. The link is emailed to the attendee and acts as their credential.

post.summary: Cancel a registration through its private link

get.summary: Download a ticket through its private link

post.summary: Check in a scanned ticket QR code
post.description: Always returns 200 with a `result`; scanners should display the outcome rather than treat DUPLICATE or INVALID as request errors. The QR signature is verified server-side.
By registration id (after a lookup) or by typing the ticket code printed under the QR code.

get.summary: Find an attendee by name, email or ticket code

post.description: Announcements, updates and reminders go to registered attendees only. Speaker and volunteer invitations go to listed addresses and must link to a published application form of this event; they are capped per event per day. Recipients who opted out are skipped and logged as SUPPRESSED.

put.description: Minutes before the start to send it; null turns it off. The default is 24 hours.

get.description: Every email sent about the event, with delivery status where the provider reports it.

get.summary: Read preferences from an unsubscribe link

patch.summary: Update preferences from an unsubscribe link (no account needed)

post.description: Configure in Brevo as `<API URL>/api/v1/webhooks/brevo?token=<BREVO_WEBHOOK_TOKEN>`.

get.description: Each figure is computed from stored records. `definitions` explains how each metric is calculated.

put.description: The text may use {{participant_name}}, {{event_name}} and {{event_date}}; {{participant_name}} is required.

get.summary: Preview the certificate as a PDF with sample values

post.description: `attended` issues to every checked-in attendee who does not have a certificate. `selected` issues to the listed confirmed registrations, whether or not they checked in (organiser authorisation).
Suspension signs the user out everywhere and hides their public events.

post.summary: Set the moderation status of an event
post.description: REMOVED hides the event everywhere and resolves its open reports; CLEAR dismisses them.
A suspended organization’s events are hidden from public listings.
